title: fisk-ai A2A v1 input question
description: Asks the caller for a free text value. Sent on the task's reply set; the header's request names the task and question_id names the question within it. The answer is an elicit reply input, where an empty string is a valid answer.

default.description: The value to pre-fill for the operator to accept or edit. Absent from a question that pre-fills nothing.
